FOR YOUR BINDER

      
Print placeholders

      
Print card-sized placeholders to hold each spot in your binder until the real card arrives. Every sheet is a 3 × 3 grid that matches a 9-pocket binder page.

      

        What to print

0 placeholders · 0 pages Print at 100% / Actual size

      

        
      

      
In your browser’s print dialog, set scale to 100% (or “Actual size”) and turn off “Fit to page” so each placeholder prints at real card size, 63 × 88 mm. Choose “Save as PDF” to keep a copy.
